assets.name: altar
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production RPG pixel-art map prop for a 32x32 tile-grid atlas. Subject: a large RUINED MEDIEVAL SANCTUM ALTAR with a shattered carved stone reredos behind it. One complete isolated grouped object. A heavy low rectangular limestone altar table in front of a damaged Romanesque triptych rear screen: central empty rounded niche, two lower broken flanking niches, chipped ornamental cornice, collapsed upper-right crest, small rubble at the base, a few unlit candle stubs on the altar. Desaturated olive-gray weathered limestone, dark joints, subtle yellow-green moss and ivy, muted warm stone highlights, solemn abandoned siege-damaged chapel. Composition fits a rectangle approximately 10 tiles wide by 8 tiles tall (320x256 final normalized size), silhouette wider than tall. Camera orthographic from DUE SOUTH looking north, pitched down exactly 45 degrees, ZERO YAW: only front and top surfaces; front horizontal edges horizontal, no left or right exterior side faces, no isometric rotation. Detailed deliberate chunky pixel clusters consistent with classic 32px RPG tiles; hard pixel edges, restrained palette. Genuinely transparent background and clear transparent margins on all sides. No floor plane, no entire room, no scenery beyond this grouped altar and attached rear screen. No figures, no skeletons, no text, no writing, no glowing magic, no floating particles, no cast shadow outside silhouette, no checkerboard painted into image. Keep whole object uncropped.
